{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the unique sites
unique_sites = data['site'].unique()
print(f'Unique sites in data: {unique_sites}')

# Check how many patients have sample_seq > 1 (re-tests)
duplicates = data[data['sample_seq'] > 1]
print(f'Number of re-tested patients (sample_seq > 1): {len(duplicates)}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
qc_failures = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]
print(f'Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {len(qc_failures)}')

# Check if patient_id is truly unique per patient
patient_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
print(f'Number of patients with >1 row: {sum(patient_counts > 1)}')"}
